description: Labelled eval cases for https://github.com/pallets/click at tag 8.5.0 (commit 8b19813f2bfca99f1018a587a8cf54fc959f2e5d). 15 identifier questions (they name a symbol), 15 paraphrases (they share no identifier with the lines they point at) and 10 no_answer questions (the corpus cannot answer them: 5 near Click's domain, 5 far from it). An expected chunk is the lines of one definition in src/click/<name>.py, read from the installed click 8.5.0, whose <name>.py is byte-identical to the tag. `note` says why a span is the answer; the seed ignores it. Check the labels with: uv run python -m tests.check_eval_cases. Five identifier questions spell `Class.method` on purpose, as a developer types it. Full-text search reads `Context.ensure_object` as `context.ensure` & `object`, so none of the five reaches its labelled chunk through full-text search (measured on the stored corpus, 2026-10-31): read the `keyword` `identifier` recall with that in mind.

cases.question: iter_params_for_processing
cases.note: The function that orders parameters for processing.

cases.question: Context.ensure_object
cases.note: Context.ensure_object: finds the object or creates it on the innermost context.

cases.question: Context.lookup_default call parameter default_map
cases.note: Context.lookup_default reads default_map and calls a callable default unless call is false.

cases.question: Group.resolve_command token_normalize_func NoSuchCommand
cases.note: Group.resolve_command looks a subcommand up, retries with the normalised name, raises NoSuchCommand.

cases.question: Option.prompt_for_value
cases.note: Option.prompt_for_value: the prompt flow, a confirm for a boolean flag and prompt otherwise.

cases.question: make_pass_decorator ensure find_object
cases.note: decorators.make_pass_decorator builds a decorator that passes the innermost object of a type.

cases.question: confirmation_option --yes
cases.note: decorators.confirmation_option adds the --yes option that prompts before continuing.

cases.question: NoSuchOption get_close_matches possibilities
cases.note: exceptions.NoSuchOption keeps close matches of the unknown option name.

cases.question: join_options any_prefix_is_slash
cases.note: formatting.join_options joins option strings and reports whether any prefix is a slash.

cases.question: _split_opt
cases.note: parser._split_opt splits an option string into its prefix and name.

cases.question: split_arg_string shlex
cases.note: shell_completion.split_arg_string splits like shlex but survives an unfinished quote.

cases.question: echo_via_pager text_or_generator
cases.note: termui.echo_via_pager shows text through the pager.

cases.question: CliRunner.isolated_filesystem temp_dir
cases.note: testing.CliRunner.isolated_filesystem: a temporary working directory for a test.

cases.question: get_app_dir force_posix roaming
cases.note: utils.get_app_dir returns the configuration folder for an application.

cases.question: format_filename shorten surrogateescape
cases.note: utils.format_filename makes a filename displayable, replacing invalid bytes.

cases.question: Stop the whole program right away with a chosen status number
cases.note: Context.exit: closes the context and raises Exit with the status.

cases.question: Produce a brief one line summary of what a subcommand does for the listing
cases.note: Command.get_short_help_str: the short help, or the long help shortened.

cases.question: Attach a nested subcommand beneath a parent so users can reach it
cases.note: Group.add_command registers a command in the group's table.

cases.question: Take a parameter's setting from shell variables, using the first one that is not blank
cases.note: Parameter.resolve_envvar_value returns the first non-empty environment variable.

cases.question: Ask the user a yes or no question and repeat until they answer properly
cases.note: termui.confirm loops until it reads yes or no.

cases.question: Read one keypress straight from the terminal without waiting for the enter key
cases.note: termui.getchar fetches a single character from the terminal.

cases.question: Hold the program until the person presses any key, unless it is not run in a terminal
cases.note: termui.pause waits for a key press and does nothing without a terminal.

cases.question: Open a path where a dash means the standard streams, with deferred opening and safe replacement writes
cases.note: utils.open_file wraps opening a file, a dash, lazy and atomic writes.

cases.question: Work out which name to show users for the running application in usage output
cases.note: utils._detect_program_name derives the program name for help text.

cases.question: Print two aligned columns of terms and their descriptions, wrapping long descriptions
cases.note: HelpFormatter.write_dl writes a definition list.

cases.question: Display a failed invocation message along with how to ask for assistance
cases.note: UsageError.show prints the usage, the help hint and the error.

cases.question: Add a flag that asks for a secret phrase with hidden typing and re-entry to verify it
cases.note: decorators.password_option sets prompt, confirmation and hidden input.

cases.question: Interpret words such as yes, no, on and off as a truthy or falsy answer, rejecting anything unrecognised
cases.note: BoolParamType.convert maps recognised strings to a boolean or fails.

cases.question: Match user input against an allowed set of options after normalisation and return the original entry
cases.note: Choice.convert finds the original choice whose normalised form matches.

cases.question: Strip terminal colour escape sequences from a string
cases.note: termui.unstyle removes ANSI styling.

cases.question: How do I make a Click command run its callback as an async coroutine?
cases.note: Near the domain: Click has no async command support.

cases.question: How does Click read option defaults from a TOML or YAML configuration file?
cases.note: Near the domain: default_map exists but no file loader.

cases.question: How do I build a full screen text interface with scrolling panes in Click?
cases.note: Near the domain: Click has prompts and a pager, no full screen UI.

cases.question: How does Click generate a man page from command definitions?
cases.note: Near the domain: Click does not generate man pages.

cases.question: How do I run Click subcommands in parallel on several threads?
cases.note: Near the domain: Click runs one command chain, with no parallelism.

cases.question: How do I configure a Postgres connection pool timeout?
cases.note: Far from the domain.

cases.question: How do I train a neural network classifier with gradient descent?
cases.note: Far from the domain.

cases.question: What is the best way to bake sourdough bread at home?
cases.note: Far from the domain.

cases.question: How do I deploy a Kubernetes ingress controller with TLS?
cases.note: Far from the domain.

cases.question: How does a websocket server broadcast messages to every connected client?
cases.note: Far from the domain.
